description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Physical Blink Stacking 2], [Physical Blink 1] and [Assault Deck Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Flare BOM
description.text: Six single attacks (3.00/3.05/3.10 each) if user has Physical Blink 0/1/2+

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Physical Blink Stacking 2
description.text: Allows to stack Physical Blink, up to Physical Blink 2

description.name: Physical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next PHY attack that deals physical, missing HP or fixed damage or NAT attack that deals physical or fractional damage

description.name: Assault Deck Follow-Up
description.text: Grants [200% ATB 1] after using Flare BOM or Split Cards if the user has any Physical Blink

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
